ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a 4:1 multiplexer, the output on the right is Z, and the two select lines at the bottom are labeled R and S; the problem states that R is the MSB, and S is the other select bit. The four data inputs on the left are connected from top to bottom to I3, I2, I1, I0: I3 is directly connected to P; I2 comes from the AND gate of P and Q, therefore I2=PQ; I1 is directly connected to P; I0 comes from the OR gate of P and Q̄, therefore I0=P+Q̄. Then reason: when R is MSB and S is LSB, the output of the 4:1 MUX is Z=R̄S̄I0+R̄SI1+RS̄I2+RSI3. Substituting each input gives Z=R̄S̄(P+Q̄)+R̄SP+RS̄(PQ)+RSP. Expand and simplify: Z=PR̄S̄+Q̄R̄S̄+PR̄S+PQRS̄+PRS. Combine PR̄S+PRS into PS, and decompose the remaining P terms according to Q/Q̄, obtaining Z=Q̄R̄S̄+PQ̄S+PQ[S+R̄S̄+RS̄]. Because S+R̄S̄+RS̄=S+S̄(R̄+R)=1, therefore Z=PQ+PQ̄S+Q̄R̄S̄.

From the text, use that \(R\) is the MSB select bit and \(S\) is the other control bit. Write the canonical MUX expression \(Z=\bar R\bar S I_0+\bar R S I_1+R\bar S I_2+RS I_3\). Substitute the four input expressions to get \(Z=\bar R\bar S(P+\bar Q)+\bar RSP+R\bar S(PQ)+RSP\). 图像描述：附图中是一个 4:1 multiplexer。右侧输出标为 Z。左侧四个数据输入从上到下标为 I3、I2、I1、I0：I3 直接接 P；I2 来自一个 AND 门，两个输入为 P 和 Q，因此 I2=PQ；I1 直接接 P；I0 来自一个 OR 门，两个输入为 P 和 Q 的反相信号 \bar{Q}，因此 I0=P+\bar{Q}。多路选择器底部有两个选择端，左边是 R，右边是 S，题目说明 R 是 MSB、S 是 LSB。

推理：按 4:1 MUX 且 R 为高位、S 为低位，选择关系为：RS=00 时选 I0，所以 Z=P+\bar{Q}；RS=01 时选 I1，所以 Z=P；RS=10 时选 I2，所以 Z=PQ；RS=11 时选 I3，所以 Z=P。把输出为 1 的情况分组：当 P=1 且 Q=1 时，I0=P+\bar{Q}=1、I1=P=1、I2=PQ=1、I3=P=1，任意选择端下输出都为 1，得到项 PQ。当 Q=0 且 S=1 时，MUX 选择 I1 或 I3，而二者都等于 P，因此要输出为 1 还需 P=1，得到项 P\bar{Q}S。当 Q=0 且 R=0、S=0 时，选择 I0=P+\bar{Q}=1，与 P 无关，得到项 \bar{Q}\bar{R}\bar{S}。合并这些项，Z=PQ+P\bar{Q}S+\bar{Q}\bar{R}\bar{S}。
